Purpose A. The same land-cover class means computed two ways: over all burned pixels of the class (the published pixel-level view) and over the burned spatial units of that class (the new view). If moving to spatial units removed the counterintuitive ordering, these two columns would rank the classes differently.

**Sources (column → raster / array).**

- `pixel_mean` — RIS_balanced over mask & class pixels
- `unit_mean_*` — mean of per-unit means from nb15_t03, unweighted and weighted by unit pixel count
